'''Chaleydonia''', more commonly known as '''Crystal City''', was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].

==History==
[[File:ChristophsisFierceTwilight.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Crystal City seen from orbit.]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Chaleydonia served as a battleground during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].

It was in this city that [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] was forced to give up his struggle to retake the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] generals [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], surrendering to their troops.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Christophsis-skylane.png|thumb|right|200px|LAAT/i gunship flying in Crystal City]]
Crystal City first appeared as such as a Christophsian city in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]], while "Chalcydonia" was first mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' as the capital city of Christophsis. However, the [[2011]] novel ''[[Shadow Games]]'' established that "Crystal City" was an alternate name for the Christophsian capital, Chaleydonia. It is therefore assumed that Chaleydonia has superseded "Chalcydonia" as the spelling for the capital city, which was merged with Crystal City.
